added_failure_note: the reviewed run recorded no baseline arm (its manifest carries baseline_suite: null and after_suite: null); its only suite log, the focused gate at after-suite.log, ends 157 passed, 2 skipped, EXIT=0 with zero FAILED ids, so no failure is added on either arm.

findings.text: the fence compares sns.claim_seq with entry.claim_seq, but claim_attempt_entry at :744-752 never puts claim_seq in the entry, so for every entry carrying a claim_token the comparison is null and the WHERE is false, and worker_compose_batches.py:54 always sets a token -- verified by constructing an entry, which has keys attempt, batch_key, id, outcome, reason, run_id, source_id and no claim_seq, so the batch_failed outcome reaches the graph zero times.

test_batch_failure_records_every_claimed_source monkeypatches record_claim_attempts with a capture, so it proves only that the helper built entries and not that any receipt is written; driving the same entries through _FakeGraphClient would have exposed the missing claim_seq, so this assertion survives the defect it was added to guard.

persist_claimed_source_outcomes is also called with status skipped (worker_extraction_and_enrichment.py:724 and :1592) and status extracted for a retried batch, so a skipped or requeued claim is recorded as refused, which misattributes it in exactly the failure census the node exists to serve.

the schema declares source_id required true at imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:3608 and run_id as a field, but no writer in any of the five stanzas sets attempt_row.source_id and only the standalone path sets run_id, so the stored node carries a null on a property the schema requires.

the docstring says the return is the number of sources that received an entry, but the query returns count(*) over rows that passed the WHERE, which counts MERGE-matched retries too, so the figure overstates new receipts under a deadlock retry.

test_ending_writer_carries_its_outcome asserts HAS_CLAIM_ATTEMPT appears somewhere in the module source, so the produced and released appends in graph_source_bindings.py are guarded by the presence of whichever stanza remains rather than by their own text.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against the base; 3882c8f7e adds the schema class and four inline stanzas, 915d3778a adds the batch-failure helper plus its text assertion, cd39d8612 adds the fragment, and every hunk sits inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks each outcome be proved on fakes and a five-failure source hold five entries; tests/standard_names/test_claim_outcome_receipts.py:155 monkeypatches record_claim_attempts out, so the one graph-writing path that carries batch_failed is never exercised and its fence defect stays green, and the after_suite log records 157 passed, 2 skipped, EXIT=0 for the focused gate only.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to record every compose claim's outcome on its StandardNameSource; imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_cost_and_claims.py:711-775 adds the receipt contract, but the batch_failed outcome is never written to the graph because the entry builder omits claim_seq while graph_cost_and_claims.py:802-804 fences on it.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it names commits 3882c8f7e, 915d3778a and cd39d8612, the focused gate command and its 157 passed 2 skipped EXIT=0, the negative control ending 1 failed, EXIT=1, and states under evidence_inputs that the full tests/standard_names arm did not complete.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source manifest declares eight write paths; git diff 96d64ea46391e6eb82d4d2676b96cad62f34c287..cd39d86124f2d81a8ec76606606653bb39454e0d changes seven files and every one of them is inside that declared set, with docs/figures/ granted and unused.

justifications.durability: removing the produced append at graph_source_bindings.py:1675 or the released append at :1385 leaves every assertion green, because tests/standard_names/test_claim_outcome_receipts.py:229 only requires the module to contain HAS_CLAIM_ATTEMPT once.
justifications.evidence: the focused gate at after-suite.log ends 157 passed, 2 skipped, EXIT=0 and negative-control.log ends 1 failed, EXIT=1, but the gate's proof for batch_failed is a monkeypatched capture at tests/standard_names/test_claim_outcome_receipts.py:155 that never reaches the query it claims to prove.
justifications.fit: the new class follows the neighbouring schema shape at imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:3083 and introduces no forbidden name, but graph_source_bindings.py:1452 coalesces b.claim_outcome, a key no writer in the repository sets, so the branch is dead and the outcome is unconditionally refused.
justifications.goal_fidelity: four of the five claim-ending writers append their outcome inside the ending statement at graph_source_bindings.py:1385,1417,1675 and orphan_sweep.py:126, but worker_compose_batches.py:54 hands the batch_failed entry a claim_token without a claim_seq so graph_cost_and_claims.py:802-804 drops it.
justifications.reuse: no prior owner exists for a per-claim attempt receipt (StandardNameSourceRetry at imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:3083 records operator releases only), yet the node builds a shared append stanza at graph_cost_and_claims.py:759 and four of its five writers hand-roll the same MERGE instead of calling it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 96d64ea..cd39d861 changes seven files and all seven are inside the write paths declared in the source manifest, with nothing touched outside them.
